# Getting help

**[Report a bug](https://github.com/garzario/ccseat/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)** · **[Request a feature](https://github.com/garzario/ccseat/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml)** · **[Ask a question](https://github.com/garzario/ccseat/discussions)**

Each form has one required box, so a few sentences are enough to start.

Where to go, depending on what you need:

| You want to | Go to |
|---|---|
| fix a setup that does not work | run `ccseat doctor`, then read [Troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md) |
| find out how something works | the [documentation](../docs/README.md) and the [FAQ](../docs/faq.md) |
| ask a question or share an idea | [Discussions](https://github.com/garzario/ccseat/discussions) |
| report a bug | a [bug report](https://github.com/garzario/ccseat/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml); the output of `ccseat doctor` helps, but it is optional |
| suggest a feature | a [feature request](https://github.com/garzario/ccseat/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) |
| report a security problem | a [private report](https://github.com/garzario/ccseat/security/advisories/new), as the [security policy](SECURITY.md) describes |

When you share output, remove emails or folder names you do not want public, and never paste a token or the contents of `.credentials.json`.

ccseat is maintained on a best-effort basis, and new issues are triaged once a week. Questions about Claude Code itself, your Claude plan or your account belong with [Anthropic's support](https://support.anthropic.com), since ccseat is an independent project.
